sources.notes: DRAFT 2026-09-22 (FA-Q-20260917-04), supplement recipe for tools/packets/massachusetts-packet-regs.txt, held in tools/recipes/drafts/. mass.gov serves the 465,227-byte PDF to plain curl with no user-agent option (sha256 f90c639146d9f2411d6d973fd48639a8836ee2b6e3e7fe0d3741d4f26bf22150 on 2026-09-22); a browser user-agent gets 403, and back-to-back fetches drew a 3,365-byte 403 now and then, so pace re-runs. If curl is refused again this source becomes chrome + attended: true, supplied with --supply-file. Sliced from 456.701's body heading plus its first words (the table of contents prints the heading followed by leader dots, so the anchor cannot land there) to the REGULATORY AUTHORITY line that follows 456.705 at the end of the document; the slice therefore also carries the page furniture after 456.705(C) (the running block, Transmittal Letter NF-64, 09/08/25), as the hand capture kept it at each page break. pdftotext -layout: the manual is single-column, so -layout and -raw agree on reading order. The standing packet was rendered by the session fetch tool, so line breaks differ.
